title: 第747章 破门而入的威严空无一人的客栈第746章 沧澜大陆第一课 洛水之誓
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
;;
东荒域，谢氏家族。
这片疆域绵延数千里，灵峰如林，阵纹流转。
若立于云端俯瞰，单是谢家这一族之地，便足有十个青阳宗那般广阔。
谢家最高峰，凌霄阁深处。
一名灰袍老者盘膝枯坐于白玉榻上。
他周身没有半点真元波动，却隐隐与周围的天地法则融为一体。
静谧中，洞府外的禁制泛起一丝涟漪。
“老祖，天弃之地来人了。”
老者缓缓睁眼。
“进来。”
石门轰然开启，一名锦衣中年大步迈入。
此人看似不过四十出头，周身溢散的灵压却让周围空间发生微微扭曲。
这赫然是一名活了一千多岁的化神期大能，谢家七祖，谢无极。
谢无极单膝跪地，神态恭敬。
“老祖，魂牌殿急报，镇守孤峰的谢长海魂牌衰败，疑似被囚。”
“最新换防的谢镇山传讯，孤峰有极其隐秘的空间波动与雷霆法则残留。”
老者面色无波，语气透着不容置疑的威严。
“查。你亲自走一趟。”
“天弃之地受法则限制，最高修为不过元婴。但此人身上承载万年大机缘，绝非寻常之辈，非化神不可看透其底细。”

“弟子领命。”
老者微微抬手，一块布满古老符文的青铜令牌飘落至谢无极面前。
“另外，派人进入天弃之地。”
“当年那人脱身之后便毁了那边的坐标，导致传送阵断联万年。如今通道再启，务必派人过去，守住阵端。”
“将那片天地，彻底化作我谢家后辈的猎场。”
谢无极双手接过令牌。
“尊老祖法旨。”
退出洞府后，他并未立刻动身。
他径直前往魂牌殿，取走谢长海那块黯淡无光的本命魂牌，这才抬手撕裂眼前虚空，一步跨入其中。
……
荒凉孤峰。
紫袍老者谢镇山正握着青铜古镜，脸色阴晴不定。
前方虚空骤然裂开一道漆黑缝隙，谢无极负手踏出。
“参见七祖！”谢镇山立刻收起古镜，躬身行礼。
谢无极没有理会他，径直走到那座古老的传送阵前。
右手虚握，周遭空气剧烈震荡。
content_en:
;;
Eastern Wasteland, Xie family.
This territory stretches for thousands of miles, with spiritual peaks like forests and flowing formations.
If you look down from the clouds, the land of the Xie family alone is as vast as ten Qingyang sects.
The highest peak of the Xie family is deep in Lingxiao Pavilion.
An old man in gray robe sat cross-legged on the white jade couch.
There was no real energy fluctuation in his body, but he was vaguely integrated with the laws of heaven and earth around him.
In the silence, there was a ripple in the restriction outside the cave.
"Ancestor, someone has come from the land abandoned by heaven."
The old man slowly opened his eyes.
"Come in."
The stone door suddenly opened, and a middle-aged man in rich clothes strode in.
This man seemed to be in his early forties, but the spiritual pressure emanating from his body caused the surrounding space to slightly distort.
This is a powerful person who has lived for more than a thousand years, the seventh ancestor of the Xie family, Xie Wuji.
Xie Wuji knelt on one knee with a respectful expression.
"Ancestor, the Soul Pavilion Palace is reporting urgently. Xie Changhai's Soul Pavilion guarding Lone Peak has declined and he is suspected of being imprisoned."
"Xie Zhenshan, who has recently changed his defense, has sent a message that there are extremely secretive spatial fluctuations and thunder law residues in Gufeng."
The old man's face was calm, and his tone showed unquestionable majesty.
"Check. Go there yourself."
"The Land Abandoned by Heaven is restricted by laws, and the highest level of cultivation is no more than Nascent Soul. But this person carries a great opportunity of ten thousand years, and he is definitely not an ordinary person. Non-gods cannot see through his details."
"Disciple accepts the order."
The old man raised his hand slightly, and a bronze token covered with ancient runes fell in front of Xie Wuji.
"In addition, send people into the abandoned land."
"After that man escaped, he destroyed the coordinates there, causing the teleportation formation to be disconnected for thousands of years. Now that the passage is reopened, we must send people over to guard the formation."
"Turn that world into a hunting ground for the descendants of my Xie family."
Xie Wuji took the token with both hands.
"Respect the laws of our ancestors."
After exiting the cave, he did not leave immediately.
He went straight to the Soul Tablet Hall and took away Xie Changhai's dim soul tablet. Then he raised his hand to tear the void in front of him and stepped into it.
…
Desolate lonely peak.
Xie Zhenshan, an old man in purple robe, is holding an ancient bronze mirror with a gloomy expression on his face.
A dark gap suddenly opened in the void ahead, and Xie Wuji stepped out with his hands behind his back.
"See the Seventh Ancestor!" Xie Zhenshan immediately put away the ancient mirror and bowed in salute.
Xie Wuji ignored him and walked straight to the ancient teleportation array.
His right hand was held empty, and the air around him shook violently.
